voc_1623-12-25.summary: Dispatch of the yacht de Hase; pepper, mace and nutmeg loaded in the Wapen and Leyden; fleet to Manila.

voc_1634-02-20.summary: Manila galleon silver at Espiritu Santo; Japan trade goods (cloths, damasks, camlets).

voc_1640-09-09_postscript.summary: The duplicate goes by the English ship Caesar, to be delivered through Cornelis Sybertsen, pastry-baker, Amsterdam.

voc_1643-01-23.summary: Japan trade hopes; Vries voyage to Tartary and the gold and silver islands east of Japan.
